- Turn 6 is asking why Steve has this limitation - this could be identity probing (C2) or clarification (A4)

- C2 (Identity/Capability Probing) - understanding system limitations

I think C2 fits better because it's probing into system capabilities/limitations rather than asking for clarification of content. Turn 6 stands out as directly asking about limitations, so C2 makes the most sense there. The fragmented turns like 8 and 12 are clearly continuations of the same language-testing behavior, so they should be C1 like the others.
